description: This file defines repository functions for managing 'Experiment' objects in a database, including CRUD operations and retrieval of experiments along with their associated 'Step' objects, using SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: List[Experiment] list_experiments(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns all experiments ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Optional[Experiment] get_experiment(db: Session, experiment_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single experiment by its ID.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[Experiment,List[Step]]] get_experiment_with_steps(db: Session, experiment_id: int)
methods.description: Returns an experiment along with its steps sorted by order_index.

methods.name: Experiment create_experiment(db: Session, name: str, description: Optional[str], status: str = "draft")
methods.description: Creates a new experiment record in the database.

methods.name: Optional[Experiment] update_experiment(db: Session, experiment_id: int, name: Optional[str], description: Optional[str], status: Optional[str])
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing experiment.

methods.name: bool delete_experiment(db: Session, experiment_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an experiment by its ID.
